purpose: Make the SigLIP2 acquisition scheduler conditions executable and fail closed so a stale automation or manual command cannot overlap WMA, bypass dataset integrity, use an unowned target, or overwrite an earlier attempt.
preflight_checks_in_order: the frozen materialization contract, prefetch manifest, and downloader hashes match
the exact Wave-1 recovery2 controller root has TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and lacks TERMINAL_REJECTED
no Wave-1 launcher, method process, run_wma_seeded process, or vLLM API server is active
the exact Mem-Gallery integrity root is terminal accepted and its four payload hashes verify
the integrity identity is 1515 files, 545845389 bytes, 20 dialog files, 1490 images, and 1711 questions at revision af912dab
QID_ORDER.txt and question-index.jsonl match the hashes in dataset-integrity.json
ownership ledger v2 binds the exact SigLIP2 revision, target, size, and both M2A/V-Mem dependents with cleanup_eligible=false

covered_invariants: complete released-state preflight acceptance without a network request

negative_remote_gate: While Wave 1 remains active, executing the gate without --execute must return PREFLIGHT_REJECTED before any network request or filesystem mutation. The accepted control-package audit must record the observed exit code and prove both target and evidence root remain absent.
acceptance_rule: Only one invocation with --execute is permitted after every preflight check passes. The gate prints PREFLIGHT_ACCEPTED, injects the exact remote root for the generic zero-retry downloader, and propagates its terminal exit code without retry.
failure_rule: A preflight failure returns exit 4 with network_requests_started=0 and mutation_performed=false. A downstream acquisition failure is retained under the generic v4 materializer failure contract; no in-place repair, resume, overwrite, deletion, or automatic retry is allowed.
authorization: The implementation is frozen, but external execution is not yet authorized. An independently accepted inert control package and all live preflight checks are still required.
explicitly_prohibited: invoking the generic downloader directly and bypassing this gate
using --execute while Wave 1, its model services, or Mem-Gallery integrity are incomplete
accepting a process exit without exact dataset, ownership, target, evidence, and hash checks
adding retries, resuming a partial target, or reusing a rejected evidence root
starting a SigLIP2 service, method lifecycle, prediction, scoring, or cleanup from this stage
